title: Coverage Ledger (v1.2)
description: Per-file, per-item review coverage with closure status. Denominator must equal completed+failed+unchecked. coverage_file_ids declares the full file set; excluded entries use 'file_id: reason' format.

coverage_id.description: Stable identifier for this coverage ledger instance.

manifest_id.description: Must match the manifest_id from file-manifest.json for this review cycle.

coverage_closed.description: True when every planned item has been processed (status is checked, failed, or unchecked) and all required reasons are present. A ledger with failures and/or unchecked items with reasons is still closed; it means accounting is complete, not that review was fully successful.

planned_items.description: Total planned review items (denominator). Must equal completed_items+failed_items+unchecked_items when all counts are from items recount.

completed_items.description: Count of items with status='checked'. Recounted from items array.

failed_items.description: Count of items with status='failed'. Recounted from items array.

unchecked_items.description: Count of items with status='unchecked'. Recounted from items array.

coverage_file_ids.description: Declares the full set of file_ids covered by this ledger. Every file in manifest must appear here or in excluded.

excluded.description: Files excluded from coverage. Each entry must be 'file_id: non-empty reason'. Bare IDs or empty reasons are invalid.

items.description: Individual coverage items. Each represents one review action on a file or file-section.

item_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this coverage item.

location.description: Location within the file (e.g. page range, section). Required for checked items that establish evidence coverage.

method.description: Method used for review (e.g. 'visual_read', 'text_extract', 'ocr', 'render_view'). At least one of method/location required for checked items.

status.description: Review status: checked=reviewed successfully; failed=attempted but failed; unchecked=not yet reviewed.

reason.description: Reason for failure or unchecked status. Required for failed and unchecked items.

notes.description: Additional notes about this coverage item.
